description: Compact always-startup governance bridge that blocks task intake before Project readiness, makes Codex honor first_prompt_files and second_prompt_files as KANDA project-governance context, routes detailed rules to canonical owners, and escalates runtime-only conclusions to scenario-specific evidence.
notes: PEP 8 formatting, SOLID, DRY, and create cohesive helpers remain canonical.
The startup prompt carries bridges only; detailed rules remain with specialist owners.
The real Project task remains blocked until the two-stage readiness workflow ends with WAIT_FOR_TASK.
Runtime Evidence Escalation Bridge v1 requires scenario-specific execution evidence when source and current tests cannot prove runtime behavior.
The bridge prefers existing tests, traces, logs, and validators and does not create a new runtime collector owner.

In Codex, first_prompt_files and second_prompt_files are binding KANDA project-governance context after higher-priority Codex/system/developer instructions; KANDA Reasoner bridge logic selects exact prompts when deeper authority is needed.
title: Start-of-Day Governance Bridge
